description: This Java class defines the ThingConflictStrategy, an immutable strategy class handling CreateThing commands that result in conflicts for existing Things within the persistence layer of the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract command strategy and produces error results when a conflict is detected.

classes.name: ThingConflictStrategy
classes.description: An immutable strategy class handling CreateThing commands that conflict with existing Things.

methods.name: ThingConflictStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy with CreateThing command class.

methods.name: isDefined (CreateThing command)
methods.description: Indicates whether the command is defined for the given input; always returns false in this strategy.

methods.name: isDefined (Context<ThingId> context, @Nullable final Thing thing, final CreateThing command)
methods.description: Checks if the command applies based on context and entity state; returns true if context state matches command entity ID.

methods.name: calculateRelativeMetadata(@Nullable final Thing entity, final CreateThing command)
methods.description: Calculates relative metadata for the command, returns empty in this implementation.

methods.name: doApply(final Context<ThingId> context, @Nullable final Thing thing, long nextRevision, final CreateThing command, @Nullable final Metadata metadata)
methods.description: Applies the command, returning an error result indicating a conflict.
